interface.signature: n: int, leftChild: List[int], rightChild: List[int] -> bool

preconditions.description: n is a positive integer within the constraint bounds.
leftChild and rightChild lists have exactly n elements each.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= child <= n - 1 for child in leftChild + rightChild)
preconditions.description: All child indices in leftChild and rightChild are either -1 (no child) or valid node indices (0 to n-1).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < n for i in range(n)) and all(0 <= child < n for child in leftChild + rightChild if child != -1)
postconditions.description: All node indices (0 to n-1) and child indices (if not -1) are valid and within bounds.
All nodes (0 to n-1) appear exactly once in the combined leftChild and rightChild lists (excluding -1).

postconditions.expression: any(i == -1 for i in leftChild + rightChild) or n == 1
postconditions.description: Either there is at least one -1 in leftChild or rightChild (indicating a leaf node), or n is 1 (single root node).

postconditions.expression: not any(i == -1 and j == -1 for i, j in zip(leftChild, rightChild) if i != -1 or j != -1)
postconditions.description: No node (except possibly the root) has both children as -1 (i.e., no internal node is a leaf).

postconditions.expression: return_value == (len(set(leftChild + rightChild) - {-1}) == n and all(0 <= child < n for child in leftChild + rightChild if child != -1) and (any(i == -1 for i in leftChild + rightChild) or n == 1) and not any(i == -1 and j == -1 for i, j in zip(leftChild, rightChild) if i != -1 or j != -1))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if and only if the nodes form exactly one valid binary tree: all nodes are connected, no cycles, no duplicate nodes, and no internal node is a leaf.
